name: Dial Dock
summary: A floating menu button that opens into a rotary phone dial you spin to change pages
about: A floating round dock for a calling app that opens into an old rotary phone dial. Each finger hole holds a page; pick one and a fingertip settles in, the wheel winds round to the chrome finger stop with ratchet lamps lighting, clacks, then springs back at a steady speed while the centre plate counts the pulses and the new page swings in. The pages work too: search contacts, play voicemail, tick notes and flip settings.
how: Press the round dock to open the dial, then click a hole, or press a number key from 1 to 6.
Use the arrow keys to move around the holes and Enter to dial; Escape or a click outside closes it.
Point at a hole to see its page name on the centre plate.
A demo plays by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
